scope: Primary-source search for publicly accessible external primary-bone-tumor radiograph cohorts beyond already screened candidates.

sources.observation: Bone-CNN article states it uses Yao et al. Figshare dataset; reports original collection as 884 anonymised radiographs and nine histology-confirmed tumor classes.
Yao et al. BTXRD dataset paper describes 3,746 images in total, including normal and tumor images; it is the Figshare collection cited by Bone-CNN.
Article reports use of BTXRD and an external clinical case series of 11 anonymised radiographs with masks; describes the series as exploratory and not an independent validation cohort.
README lists 11 case pairs: 7 benign and 4 malignant, with masks; repository page does not display a data license.

IIEST Yadav & Rathor 2020 is cited as a small bone-X-ray dataset; BTXRD paper reports 217 images, including 69 cancer-labelled, 99 fractured, and 49 healthy images. No verified image package, dataset license, adjudication details, or patient/image manifest was found in this review.

RadFM 2025 states MedPix data require review of the official license and a download request; it says Radiopaedia data are subject to licensing restrictions and requires approval from Radiopaedia licensing before the authors provide the detailed download link. This makes source-level rights/terms for BTXRD Center 2/3 an open provenance question even though the BTXRD Figshare record is listed CC BY 4.0.

NLM states MedPix images and case materials were contributed by many individuals and curated for personal use and local teaching; for other uses, users should contact the original contributor for additional permission.

assessment.reported_image_count_discrepancy: Bone-CNN reports 884 original images while the cited Yao BTXRD data paper reports 3,746 total images. Same cited Figshare lineage; without an image manifest or author clarification, do not treat 884 as a separate cohort or infer exact subset mapping.
frontiers_11_case_series_gaps: no normal/negative group for specificity or false-positive estimation
repository has no displayed data license
no independent diagnostic adjudication established in the reviewed article
patient-level manifest and overlap clearance unavailable
assessment.disposition: NO NEW ELIGIBLE COHORT; G4 REMAINS OPEN
assessment.additional_search_result: No additional eligible independently accessible primary-bone-tumor radiograph cohort was identified. IIEST is an additional small mixed cancer/fracture/healthy lead (C15) with no verified image package, reuse rights, reference-standard detail, or overlap manifest; recent modeling papers reuse BTXRD or describe request-only cohorts already tracked. Focused repository-portal searches (Zenodo, Figshare, Mendeley Data, Kaggle) added no eligible cohort; C11 restricted Zenodo and C15 IIEST remain individually tracked.
assessment.btxrd_upstream_rights_chain_gap: BTXRD includes images sourced from Radiopaedia and MedPix, and Yao et al. state compliance with their terms. A separate 2025 publisher data statement describes request/approval restrictions for those source collections. Preserve dataset-level Figshare license evidence, but require image/source-level provenance and rights-chain clarification before asserting that all upstream images are covered for every BoneScope use or redistribution. Official NLM guidance separately states MedPix material is for personal/local teaching and asks users to seek contributor permission for other uses.

limitations: Literature screening only; does not establish rights, dataset availability, patient-level independence, or clinical validity.
candidate_register_status: C14 Frontiers and C15 IIEST are recorded as NOT ELIGIBLE / NOT EVALUABLE; see their candidate-specific screen records.

additional_primary_source_hits.finding: The 2026 attention-model study uses the same 3,746-image BTXRD dataset; it does not report a distinct external image cohort.

The 2026 SKELEX article describes BTXRD Centers 2/3 as external evaluation sets for its own model. These are source centers within BTXRD, not a new BoneScope-independent cohort; original BTXRD data lack patient/examination IDs adequate to establish patient-level separation.
PMC full text for SKELEX reports external evaluation using BTXRD Centers 2 and 3; existing C08 SNUH-BoneTumor is the same 19,757-image request-only resource, not a newly released cohort.

The BTXRD primary dataset paper identifies IIEST as a separate small dataset but describes it as only 69 bone-tumor images among 217 mixed healthy/fracture/cancer images; not an eligible independent BoneScope validation cohort without rights, label/reference-standard, package, and overlap verification.

RadFM publisher data statement describes licensing restrictions for MedPix and Radiopaedia image reuse, with request/approval pathways. Because BTXRD includes both sources and a dataset-level CC BY 4.0 record, this project still needs source/image-level rights-chain evidence or clarification; do not assume the archive license alone proves upstream rights or expand redistributive uses.
additional_primary_source_hits.implication: G4 rights-chain action for BoneScope training/evaluation data; does not create a new cohort candidate.

additional_primary_source_hits.finding: Official NLM Open-i guidance says MedPix contributor images/case material are for personal and local institutional teaching; other purposes require contacting the contributor for permission.
additional_primary_source_hits.implication: Supports preserving image-level MedPix rights grants in the BTXRD/BoneScope rights chain; not a legal determination about the Figshare record.

findings.finding: The focused primary-bone-tumor radiograph result was the already-screened Tu et al. record C11; Zenodo page identifies 10.1 GB files as restricted and displays no license.
The focused search returned BTXRD and papers reusing that collection; no distinct eligible independent tumor-radiograph collection was verified.
No separately accessible primary-bone-tumor radiograph cohort with verifiable rights/provenance was confirmed in the focused results; knee osteoarthritis datasets are task-mismatched.
Search results were mostly unverified reposts, task-mismatched bone/fracture/osteoporosis data, or sources without a clear upstream rights chain; none added as eligible.

repository_portal_scan.limitations: Search-engine portal scan is not exhaustive and does not establish absence of other datasets; candidate-specific page and source-paper review remains necessary.
